cues.text: Hello, First Choice Car Rental! How may I help you?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Oh, good morning. Um, I’m calling for some information about your car renting services.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: I’m an Example American, and I will be going on a family holiday to your city from Ohio next month.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: OK. no problem. It’s our pleasure to serve you.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Could you please tell me your name and contact information first?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: I'm Carroline. C-A -R-O-L-I-N-E, and my telephone number is 0419 6570 156
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: OK. I’ve got that. And how can I send you our quotation, if you are satisfied with our arrangement?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Is email all right, or should I send it by post?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: The latter, please! I’m afraid I’d prefer to read it on paper.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: That’s no problem.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: I’m considering renting a caravan for a week, but I don’t really know the price range for it, since I haven’t rented any car through that method before.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: I think it should be within my budget of $50.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: You know, we have various caravans at different renting prices, according to the class of vehicle, facilities inside, mileage, etc.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: I’d recommend the ‘Explorer’, taking your budget into consideration, which is of good value and will cost you  $39 per day. Is that OK?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Of course, that’s fine for me! I know the ‘Explorer’.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: That could save me $11 each day! You know a family holiday will be costly. That van is perfect!
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: I’m glad that you like it. So do you have any particular requirements about your room in the van?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Um, how many beds are there?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: One twin bed.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: But there are three of us, my mum, my daughter and me. So can we   add another bed?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: No problem.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: For the facilities, I think a kitchen is the most important, and of course the stove.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: In our vans, such as ‘Explorer’, there are all the basic bedding materials you need, like pillows and blankets, as well as some equipment for daily life.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: And many things can be added into your room according to your needs, such as a coffee maker.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Well,I need to have a heater, in case it’ll be cold at night, and a microwave of course.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: All right, I’ve taken notes of all these things.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Actually, all our vans should be taken from our company, which is not too far from the city centre, so we can pick you up from the centre for free. Is that OK?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Oh, I’m afraid we’d better be picked up from the airport, as we are foreigners in your country and not familiar with the transport system. Is that alright?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Yes, it is no problem. With that comes the information for the insurance. I need the driver’s name and age.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: That is my daughter Chris, who is 19, the youngest driver amongst us three.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Man:	I’m sorry, but our company only accepts caravan drivers aged 25 or over, according to our regulations. So...
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Well, that would be me, Caroline,and I’m 49 years old.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: And where was your driving licence issued? I mean the country.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: I’ve got a licence in America, but I’ve also got one in Australia which is still valid.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Is it better for me to register the local one from your country?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Yes, that might be better. So your registration number is...
cues.speaker: Man
